name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 82 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 82 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israeli air strikes have continued to target senior Hamas security officials in Gaza, killing at least two named figures, while Israel has redirected $90 million from border community recovery budgets to defense and detained a Polish lawmaker ahead of a West Bank visit. Gaza health officials have warned of a rising meningitis epidemic and a night of arson has been linked to Israeli Jewish terrorism, and Israel's top court described West Bank settlers as acting like militias. Israeli minister Ben-Gvir has been accused of seeking a religious war over mosque raids, and Israel has pledged to advance delayed sewage repairs in Gaza under international pressure. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israels luftangrep har fortsatt rettet seg mot høytstående Hamas-sikkerhetsoffiserer i Gaza, og har drept minst to navngitte personer, mens Israel har omdisponert 90 millioner dollar fra gjenoppbyggingsbudsjetter for grenseområdene til forsvar og har fengslet en polsk lovgiver før et besøk i Vestbredden. Gaza-helsemyndighetene har advart om en økende meningitt-epidemi, og en natt med brannstiftelse er knyttet til israelsk jødisk terrorisme, og Israels høyesterett beskrev Vestbreddens bosettere som handlende som militsgrupper. Israelsk minister Ben-Gvir er blitt anklaget for å søke en religiøs krig over moskeerazzasjer, og Israel har lovet å fremskynde utsatte avløpsreparasjoner i Gaza under internasjonalt press. Konflikten har forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
